title: Filled topographic contours
intent: Show nested level sets from a regularly sampled scalar field.

ai.create: Create five filled topographic contours from a typed regular grid. Plot should use contour; TanStack should inject d3-contour and render the returned GeoJSON paths through a local custom mark.
ai.maintain: Keep the threshold sequence, grid dimensions, vertical orientation, and literal contour palette aligned across both implementations without importing spatial code into the chart core.
